question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Regardless of their __diversity__, all flowers have a uniform function, the reproduction of the species through the production of seed.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Uniformity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Diversity**: The state of being diverse; variety. (विभिन्नता)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Melancholy**: A feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause. (अवसाद)
 
• **Equilibrium**: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced. (संतुलन)
 
• **Affinity**: A natural liking for and understanding of someone or something. (आकर्षण)
 
• **Uniformity**: The quality or fact of being the same, or of not changing or being different in any way. (एकरूपता)
 
 
• **For example-** *Government inspections ensure a high degree of **uniformity **in the standard of service.*
 
 
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Diversity**' is '**Uniformity**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
